title: 2022 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nasser Al-Attiyah / Mathieu Baumel (Toyota Gazoo Racing) and Sam Sunderland (Gas Gas Factory Team)
summary: The 2022 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 8 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Nasser Al-Attiyah / Mathieu Baumel (Toyota Gazoo Racing); Bikes: Sam Sunderland (Gas Gas Factory Team); Quads: Alexandre Giroud (Yamaha Racing - SMX - Drag'On); Light prototypes: Francisco Lopez Contardo / Juan Pablo Latrach Vinagre (EKS - South Racing); UTVs: Austin Jones / Gustavo Gugelmin (Can-Am Factory South Racing).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
